title: Gapped graphene model: shift current and SHG
summary: The honeycomb tight-binding model with a 1 eV sublattice gap (D3h): shift current, injection currents and second-harmonic susceptibility of the sheet from PAOFLOW.nonlinear_optics, with the selection rules yyy = -yxx = -xxy and xxx = 0, and the same model with inversion, where every response vanishes. No DFT run; under a minute.

steps.label: Shift current, injection currents and SHG of gapped graphene, with and without inversion
steps.note: 300 x 300 k-points, under a minute on one core; writes output/ and output_inv/ and prints the symmetry checks
